parts.text: APPLICATION FOR CONSENT TO FILE AN INFORMATION
parts.why: The subject heading. Source: Criminal Litigation drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).

parts.text:
I am the {{applicantOffice}} and I hereby apply for consent to file an information on a charge of {{offence}} against {{defendant}}.

Investigation into the case has been concluded and all the witnesses the prosecution intends to call in proof of its case are available. Attached to this application are:
#. a copy of the proposed information;
#. the unedited statement of the alleged offender;
#. the proof of evidence; and
#. the list of exhibits to be relied upon.

This application is made on behalf of the Attorney-General of {{state}}. No previous application for consent has been made in respect of this information.
parts.why: States the charge and the defendant, that investigation is complete and witnesses available, lists the documents attached (proposed information, statement, proof of evidence, exhibits), and confirms no earlier application was made. Source: Criminal Litigation drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).
Signed by the prosecuting officer. Source: Criminal Litigation drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).

fields.label: Prosecuting officer

fields.label: Office
fields.question: Their office, for example: Director of Public Prosecutions, Ministry of Justice, Lagos State.

fields.label: Date
fields.question: What date should the application bear?

fields.label: State
fields.question: Which State? For example: Lagos State.

fields.label: Address of the judiciary
fields.question: The address of the State judiciary.

fields.label: Offence
fields.question: What is the charge? For example: stealing.
